item.title: Jim Cramer Will “Thank the Shortseller for a Discount” on AMD. Is the China Risk Overblown?
item.description:
AI summary: AMD fell 8% on Thursday after Hunterbrook Media published a report titled "AMD Has Its Own China Problem," which alleged that Chinese server maker IEIT Systems, blacklisted by the Commerce Department in March 2025, built newer versions of AMD's startup firmware into its server updates; the stock fell another 13% on Friday to $424.39 as tech sold off.
